_what: Pre-deletion baseline for wp-2608241500-hex-solo P0.1. P9.1 compares against this.
_honest_caveat: P0.1 asked for this BEFORE any extraction. It was not taken then. These numbers are from 2026-09-11, after P2 (hex-infer extraction), P3 (SpacetimeDB severed from hex-exec) and the P6.2 repoints of graph/analyze/bench/do — but BEFORE any deletion phase. So it is a baseline for the deletion, not for the whole collapse. The risky change for loop quality was inference going in-process, and that is already inside these numbers rather than measured against them.

binary._note: The survey recorded 14,159,856 bytes at the workplan's HEAD. It has grown since. S09 expects at least 3.4 MB of that to come back when the 8 embedded WASM blobs go (see the consumer trace, which corrects S09's 1.5 MB figure).

transitive_deps._note: Counted with `cargo tree --prefix none | sort -u`. The survey's figures (34/139/244/363/584) used a different method; compare P9 numbers against THESE, measured the same way.

self_analysis._note: P9.2 requires A or better over the surviving workspace.

agentic._status: partial — one fixture, verified by hand
agentic._why: The full corpus is 12 fixtures x 2 arms x N models and is P9.1's job. This single run exists to demonstrate spec S01: the canonical loop completes an evidence-gated task with NO daemon running and no connection to 127.0.0.1:5555.

observed_gaps.registry_model_list_is_stale: ~/.hex/inference-servers.json lists only [gemma4-12b] for the local ollama endpoint, while the server actually serves 20 models. Nothing refreshes it now that config_sync is gone. Routing still works — a bare model id with no vendor slug falls through to first_local — but `serves_model` matching is effectively dead for local endpoints.
observed_gaps.text_shaped_tool_calls: qwen2.5-coder:14b sometimes emits tool calls as bare JSON objects in `content` rather than structured tool_calls. extract_text_mode_tool_uses only recognises FENCED ```json envelopes, so the loop reads zero tool uses and ends with no edit. Pre-existing; not caused by the in-process move (the JSON shape is identical by construction).
observed_gaps.no_progress_guard: Observed the ReAct loop repeat an identical failing propose_edit 76 times in one run. The no-progress counter did not stop it.
